name: Sally Smith
title: Contact Psychologist
description: I am an empathetic and collaborative psychologist who works with adolescents and adults. I place great importance on creating a judgment free safe space. I am particularly passionate about supporting women and LGBTQIA+ people. I draw from various evidence-based interventions including Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, Dialectical Behavioural Therapy, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy and Schema Therapy.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex worker issues, Diverse genders, Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Dr Lei Gryffydd
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Dr Lei is a senior clinical neuropsychologist who specialises in the assessment and management of neurocognitive conditions, including Autism and ADHD. They also provide ongoing therapy and targeted interventions, with special interests in the areas of executive functioning, social communication, memory, and learning.
specialties: Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Diverse sexualities

name: Dr Eraj Ghafoori
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: I am passionate about helping individuals understand themselves better! In addition to private clients, I work with Medicare rebate, WorkSafe, TAC and other insurers.
specialties: Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Jarred Pennington
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
address: 644 Chapel St, Como Centre, Como Tower Plus Telehealth
description: I've noticed no matter why someone comes to therapy, their issues usually result in relationship problems of some kind. E.g, if depressed you are likely to avoid others even though you may also be lonely. I tend to focus on problems of emotional control such as personality disorders/traits, depression, anxiety, eating disorders, trauma, grief and loss.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex worker issues, Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities

name: Kirsty Moodie
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
address: 10 River Street, Bupa Mindplace at River Street Medical
description: Kirsty is a Registered Psychologist and Educational and Developmental Psychology Registrar who works with children, adolescents and adults, and has a particular interest in neurodivergence, including Autism and ADHD, as well as individuals experiencing anxiety, emotional regulation difficulties, and learning challenges. Kirsty works at Mindplace South Yarra in Riverside Medical Centre, a co-located GP and mental health clinic network backed by Bupa.

name: Dr Sarah Pearse
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Dr Sarah Pearse has 25 years experience providing psychological assessment & treatment to adults with PTSD & Complex Trauma, First Responder PTSD and stress, childhood abuse, sexual assault, anxiety, panic, depression, adjustment, grief & loss. Sarah is supportive, empathetic & respectful, assisting clients to safely & confidently explore & reflect on their issues & strengths. Sarah is an EMDR practitioner and also uses strategies from Cognitive Behaviour Therapies, Acceptance & Commitment Therapy, and Trauma- and attachment-focussed therapies.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Diverse genders, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Ebony Collins
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Ebony has a warm and engaging style to her treatment. She aims to work collaboratively with all clients. This has led to a special interest in working with adults and adolescents suffering from personality disorders, schizophrenia, and trauma.
specialties: Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities

name: Thomas Kenny
title: Contact Psychologist
description: Tom has a warm, empathetic, non-judgmental and down-to-earth style, offering respect and open-mindedness to every client. Tom’s therapeutic approach is tailored for each individual’s needs and personal goals, while drawing upon the principals of Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Person-Centred Therapy, and Emotion-Focused Therapy. Tom is an Irish native who did his undergraduate training and Masters of Psychology (Educational & Developmental) in Melbourne at Australian Catholic University.
specialties: Diverse genders, Sexual difficulties, Diverse sexualities
